text: The return policy states that products can be returned if they are undamaged and complete. You are allowed to try the product, but items with signs of use are not accepted. You only need the order number for the return; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date; after 30 days, returns are not accepted and the product will be evaluated under warranty. If you use the contracted carrier Anadolu Kargo for the return, the shipping is free by showing the return code at the branch. If you use your own carrier, the shipping cost will not be refunded. After the product arrives at the warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, the refund will be made to the account holder's IBAN.
